description: Printable Toronto building permit document checklist for a commercial change of use or interior alteration, from the City of Toronto Building guide. Organizes forms and drawings only. Document organizer only. It is not a permit determination or a fee estimate. The City of Toronto examiner and your designer decide what the application needs.

assembly_work.description: The project changes wall or floor assemblies, fire separations, stairs, guards or handrails.

designer.description: Who prepares the drawings: architect_engineer, other_designer, or owner_exempt (a property owner exempt from qualification).

exterior_work.description: The project includes exterior, parking or loading changes.

professional_review.description: Whether the Building Code requires professional design and field review: yes, no or unsure.

roof_work.description: The project includes roof changes or new rooftop equipment.

name: change_of_use_document_checklist
